leadText: Emiko Yoshino (Japanese: よしのえみこ / 吉野恵美子) is a manga illustrator that has created artwork for Pokémon and regularly works on official Pokémon-related media.
plainText:
Emiko Yoshino (Japanese: よしのえみこ / 吉野恵美子) is a manga illustrator that has created artwork for Pokémon and regularly works on official Pokémon-related media.

==Credits==
===Manga===
Pokémon XD: Whirlwind of Darkness, Dark Lugia
Pokémon Ranger: The Road to a "Capture" Master
Pokémon Ranger Vatonage: Mission Clear
Pokémon Stories Together with Pikachu!
Lucario and the Mystery of Mew
Pokemon Ruby & Sapphire Special Capture Comic!
3 Friends Pokémon Story
Pokémon Diamond & Pearl Quiz Encyclopedia
Pokémon HeartGold & SoulSilver Complete Quiz Encyclopedia
Pokémon Black & White Quiz Encyclopedia
Pokémon Black 2 & White 2 Quiz Encyclopedia
Pokémon X & Y Quiz Encyclopedia
Search for Pokémon! Sun & Moon
Pokémon Sun & Moon - Let's Play With Pokémon!

===Games===
Detective Pikachu - Pokémon Graphic Supervisor
Pokémon Quest - Pokémon Graphic Supervisor
Pokémon Picross - Pokémon Graphic Supervisor
Pokémon Rumble World - Pokémon Graphic Supervisor
Pokémon Duel - Pokémon Brand Management
Pokémon Sword and Shield - Special Thanks
Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee! - Special Thanks
Pokémon Sun and Moon - Special Thanks
Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire - Special Thanks
Pokémon Battle Trozei - Special Thanks

===Animation===
Pokémon the Movie: The Power of Us - Production Committee
Pokémon: Mewtwo Strikes Back—Evolution - Production Committee

==Other==
Emiko Yoshino created a special set of illustrations for the Pokémon Daisuki Club .
